run_manifest.rule_vintage: Act 2025 / Finance Act 2026 component mapping as recorded in tax_rules_asof.md; TY 2026-27 calculator held constant

scope: 120/122-month synthetic mechanics; no investable return or investor-specific tax/wealth result

assumptions.fund_return: 5% per year simple synthetic NAV appreciation, applied linearly by month; no distribution stream is modeled
assumptions.bond_terms: par-priced direct-bond fixture; 5% annual cash coupon; principal returned at par
assumptions.external_tax_inputs: explicit synthetic ₹30 lakh ordinary income in every modeled year; no credits/deductions
assumptions.staged_sale: 50% of each fund lot at terminal month-end; remaining units sold on following 1 April
assumptions.fees: zero solely for mechanics fixture; real fees remain unknown
assumptions.tax_rule_vintage: TY 2026-27 component code applied unchanged to all modeled years
assumptions.cash_tax_timing: tax liability is deducted from terminal fixture wealth; interim payment/reinvestment is not simulated
assumptions.real_wealth: not calculated; CPI base and actual dates are unconfirmed

2036-37.tax_component_scope: RESEARCH_COMPONENT_ONLY; not a personal tax result
